env.name: TAXBRAIN_MCP_CASELAW_INDEX
env.description: Optional path to a JSONL case-law metadata index ({title, court, ...}) to enable the find_case_law lexical search. Unset => find_case_law returns an empty result set. No corpus ships with the package.
